title: Compact Cost Rail — visual audit, interaction tuning, and stakeholder signoff
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Create a compact, left-anchored cost rail variant for the Console dashboard that surfaces top-level cost KPIs and quick drilldowns while preserving accessibility, predictable motion, and low cognitive overhead. Scope includes visual audit against existing tokens, updated spacing and type scale for 3 density breakpoints, microinteraction specs (hover, focus, expand/collapse), and a short prototype to validate rollouts and canary messaging. This ticket captures design iterations, stakeholder feedback, QA redlines, and sign-off criteria required for dev handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Compact cost rail adheres to Console token system and passes visual audit (color, elevation, type scale) across 3 density modes.
Interaction states documented: idle/hover/focus/pressed/disabled with 60ms/120ms motion timings and reduced-motion variant.
Accessible keyboard and screen-reader flows documented and validated by accessibility engineer.
Prototype (Figma + interactive) demonstrates expand/collapse, drilldown transition, and empty/error states.
Design handoff file includes responsive specs, symbol library updates, and a single QA checklist for engineers.
Stakeholder signoff captured from PM, Eng, and Design Ops before moving to implementation.
design_notes: Rail is 280px wide in default density, 230px in compact, and 340px in relaxed — values derived from visual rhythm and token baselines.
Primary KPI row uses 16/600 label + 20/700 value token pairing; secondary metrics use 12/600 to maintain hierarchy.
Use subtle elevation (shadow level 2) with 6px corner radius to keep visual separation from dashboard canvas.
Iconography: replace multi-color icons with single-tone semantic icons for better legibility at small sizes.
Motion: expand uses 120ms ease-out for container and 60ms stagger for inner rows; reduced-motion disables stagger.
Shrink-to-indicator behavior: when viewport squeezes below 960px, rail collapses to compact pill (40px) with tooltip hover and persistent keyboard focus target.
Edge cases: negative or zero costs should use muted red with -$ prefix and tooltip explanation; extremely long account names truncate with accessible ellipsis and full-name tooltip.
Data states: loading shimmer for KPIs, skeleton for list items, and explicit error CTA (Retry) for failed fetches.
Interaction handoff tokens included in file: spacing-xs/sm/md, type-scale-xs/sm/md, radius-sm/md, elevation-2.
Analytics hooks: add click events for KPI drilldowns, collapse/expand toggles, and external link opens (consent logged).
decisions: Opted for a left-anchored persistent rail instead of a floating overlay to minimize layout shift for main dashboard charts.
Used single-tone semantic icons for compact mode to improve scanability at smaller sizes.
Preserve focusability of collapsed rail via a 40px pill to satisfy keyboard users and screen readers.
Motion timings chosen to balance perceived snappiness with continuity across the Console (120ms / 60ms pattern).
stakeholder_feedback: PM (Jon Wu): prefers KPI ordering to reflect monthly spend, growth%, then anomalies — asked for a toggle in the future for custom ordering.
Eng (Priya Nair): requested explicit edge-case list for long account names and guidance on server-side truncation/tooltip triggers.
Design Ops (Marco Rossi): asked to align token names with global token library before merge to avoid a separate token migration PR.
Data (Elena Garcia): flagged need for placeholder values when metrics are delayed by >1s to avoid janky layout shifts.
Accessibility (Samir Khan): requested ARIA roles for the rail group, labelled controls for collapse/expand, and a reduced-motion variant — incorporated.
Release Manager (Tara Bloom): requested a feature flag for staged rollout and a canary audience of 10% for Dedicated customers first.
qa_findings: Keyboard focus order was incorrect in prototype — focus moved to content before the collapse button; fixed by reordering DOM and adding skip link.
Contrast issues on secondary metrics in compact mode (12px label) — increased weight to 600 for target contrast.
Tooltip on collapsed pill flickered on rapid hover — adjusted debounce to 150ms and improved pointer hit area.
Mobile breakpoint collapse threshold caused overlap with top nav on narrow screens — increased collapse breakpoint to 960px and added z-index isolation.
Performance note: excessive SVG icon complexity caused repaint spikes on older GPUs; simplified path and switched to system icon font for compact set.
